summary: The feature is implemented but unverified: I did not run tests, flake8, or any repository code, as instructed. Changes: new monai/data/csv_saver.py (CSVSaver) and monai/data/nifti_saver.py (NiftiSaver); write_nifti default dtype is now np.float32; plot_2d_or_3d_image added to monai/visualize/img2tensorboard.py; SegmentationSaver, ClassificationSaver, and TensorBoardImageHandler rewritten as thin adapters with the spec's new signatures (index added to the TB handler, filename added to the classification saver, output_path renamed to output_dir). Callers updated in two segmentation examples and tests/integration_sliding_window.py. Classification test passes filename. New tests: test_csv_saver.py, test_nifti_saver.py, test_handler_segmentation_saver.py, test_plot_2d_or_3d_image.py. docs/source/data.rst gained entries for the new modules. Lint was checked only by reading and grep: line length, comma spacing, continuation alignment, and file endings look correct. Nothing is committed. Open choices: the TB handler's ValueError wording was kept verbatim, including the misleading 'output_transform(...)[0]' message for the input tag; the RGB CHW path is not rescaled, matching the original.
